requirement: 29 CFR 1910.35 details egress for structures sufficiently for offshore substations under the exit-route provisions of NFPA 101.
Required codes regarding communications on offshore platforms should be the same as the CCTV standards, NFPA 70 and IEEE C2.
scope: Offshore platforms, specifically for communications equipment
source: NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code, 2014), IEEE C2 (National Electrical Safety Code, 2012)
related_domains: electrical safety; communications systems; offshore infrastructure design
